data.title: 久岛鸥 · 烛光木屋里的真情流露
data.description: 暴风雨夜的废弃山中小屋里，烛火在潮湿的风中摇曳。白色的长睡裙薄如蝉翼，鸥紧紧依偎在怀中，褪去了白天的古灵精怪，像一只容易受惊的小鹿般微微发抖。
data.location: rustic weathered mountain cabin with rain drumming fiercely against windowpanes
data.action: huddling close on wool blanket, sheer heirloom nightdress slipping from trembling shoulders, clinging to partner chest with tear-brimmed eyes
data.lighting: fragile amber glow of a single tallow candle dancing across damp wooden walls
data.mood: fragile tender vulnerability, storm-sheltered passion, heartbreakingly sweet trust
data.promptProse: Shivering in a dimly lit storm cabin, Kamome clings tightly in her sheer white nightgown, looking up with tearful affectionate eyes.
data.animaCaption: Kamome seeking shelter in a storm cabin, holding on tight in delicate nightwear.
